verdict.rationale: LocalAI's built-in web interface manages model installations and agent configuration, and it lets you install models from a gallery Discover page. That covers the downloaded-models part of the story in one place. Model aliasing touches on per-model settings, but there is no documented saved-prompt library, and editing saved chat messages is chat history rather than reusable prompts. missing for 10: saved/reusable prompt management, per-model configuration editing in the same UI, independent or hands-on corroboration of the unified management view.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can manage my downloaded models, saved prompts, and per-model configurations in one place

citations.quote: LocalAI comes with a **built-in web interface** for chatting with models, managing installations, configuring AI agents, and more, with no extra tools needed.
Install models from the built-in gallery (Discover page)
You can now set up model aliases, meaning you can call your favorite complex model name by a simpler, custom nickname.
